movelist.name: Hidden Power
movelist.effect: When a Pokémon first obtains the Move Hidden Power, roll 1d20. Hidden Power’s Elemental Type will be changed from Normal to Bug on a result of 1; Dark on 2; Dragon on 3; Electric on 4; Fairy on 5; Fighting on 6; Fire on 7; Flying on 8; Ghost on 9; Grass on 10; Ground on 11; Ice on 12; Normal on 13; Poison on 14; Psychic on 15; Rock on 16; Steel on 17; Water on 18; and on 19 or 20, reroll until you roll another number. This effect is permanent –if Hidden Power is forgotten and relearned, the chosen Type remains the same.

movelist.name: Meditate
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Force Palm
movelist.effect: Force Palm Paralyzes the target on 18+.

movelist.name: Feint
movelist.effect: If a foe uses a Move with the Shield Keyword in response to one of your actions, you may activate Feint to cause the triggering Move to Fail. Feint is activated as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Detect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Detect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

abilities.name: Pure Power
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s base attack stat is doubled. This may double any bonuses from Nature or Vitamins, but not bonuses from Features. Ability List: Q–U

abilities.name: Scrappy
abilities.effect: Ghost Types are not immune to the user’s Normal and Fighting-Type Moves.
